categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Chase Sun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in six business segments: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formula granules, finished pharmaceutical products, medical devices, pharmaceutical raw materials and excipients, healthcare services, and intelligent pharmaceutical supply chain. The company focuses on research, production, and sales across these segments, with key products including blood purification injection, low molecular weight heparin calcium injection, and various TCM formula granules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates traditional Chinese medicine processing with modern automated production lines, employing digital characterization and quality control systems to ensure consistency and efficacy. It uses advanced manufacturing execution systems (MES), SCADA, and ERP systems for intelligent manufacturing and supply chain management. In pharmaceutical production, it applies automated process control and online quality monitoring, while in medical devices, it develops electronic health monitoring and management solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals, medical institutions with TCM qualifications, healthcare providers, and pharmaceutical distributors across China. Its products target critical care, oncology, cardiovascular, respiratory, and neurological diseases. The healthcare services segment caters to patients via online and offline TCM clinics, while medical devices serve both domestic and international markets including the US, Canada, India, Germany, Singapore, and Australia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in China with production bases in Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Hubei, Henan, Chongqing, Gansu, and Shandong. The company also has overseas subsidiaries and markets in the United States, Canada, India, Germany, Singapore, Australia, and Hong Kong. Domestic sales cover all major regions including East China, North China, Central China, South China, Southwest, Northwest, Northeast, and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream raw material production (pharmaceutical raw materials and excipients), midstream manufacturing (finished drugs and medical devices), and downstream distribution and healthcare services. It also manages an intelligent pharmaceutical supply chain platform integrating procurement, logistics, and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven development, digital transformation, and intelligent manufacturing. The company emphasizes R&D in critical care drugs, oncology, immunology, and TCM formula granules, with ongoing clinical trials and new drug development projects. It invests in digital platforms, AI integration, and supply chain optimization to enhance operational efficiency and product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pharmaceuticals, TCM formula granules, medical devices, and pharmaceutical raw materials. Additional income comes from healthcare service fees and intelligent supply chain services. The company also receives government subsidies and occasional investment income, but product sales dominate its revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a leading player in the Chinese pharmaceutical industry, ranking among the top 100 Chinese pharmaceutical companies and top 30 listed TCM companies. It competes in the TCM formula granules market, finished drug market, and medical device sector against numerous domestic and international firms. Its competitive advantages lie in its integrated industrial chain, innovation capabilities, and quality management systems.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately 5.78 billion RMB, a 5.34% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders declining by 95.76% to about 21.47 million RMB. The company has total assets of around 11.17 billion RMB and equity of approximately 8.64 billion RMB. Despite recent profit declines, it maintains a substantial scale with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes the integration of traditional Chinese medicine heritage with modern technology to deliver high-quality, standardized TCM formula granules and innovative pharmaceutical products. Its 'Full Component®' TCM granules maintain clinical efficacy while improving patient convenience. The company also highlights its advanced intelligent manufacturing, rigorous quality control, and comprehensive supply chain capabilities as key differentiators that ensure product safety, efficacy, and cost competitiveness.
